as_of_31Mar.qualitative: B+/A- four-deck combat-system recovery; cadre depth improving, repeated-strike endurance still below late-1942/43 Branch peak.

four_core.Palau_effect: No combat loss from DESECRATE I because the four-core is not committed. Training tempo is briefly reduced while readiness rises, but regeneration continues.

Taiho.21_25Mar: Passes southward-release gate after home-area work-up; conducts transit/deck training rather than combat sortie.
Taiho.31Mar_combat_credit: Useful as an independent/limited supporting carrier and for CAP/search/one-cycle strike; still not fully credited inside a five-deck synchronized mass strike.
Taiho.integration_location: Davao-Celebes/southern training axis by end-March centered; exact anchorage is rotated for security.

five_carrier_gate: Remains centered 10-20 Apr for full synchronized mass-strike credit, compatible with the existing 30-Apr B+ Taiho checkpoint.
guard: Do not treat Palau survival as free training time: local aviation suffers heavily, but the mobile carrier-air cadre is intentionally preserved.
